name: Harbourmaster Absalom

intro.text: Forty years I've run this harbour. I've seen the tall ships come in, the Matthew sail out and a statue go in. I've never seen you beat me.
Full team, mind. Six. Bristol fashion.

win: Well. You'll do. You'll do very nicely.
after: Come back when the tall ships are in. You'll never see the harbour so full.
